description: How your club plays and how to play the next opponent, read from the numbers: shape in possession (formation, build-up route, pass accuracy, which side the attacks lean to), shape out of possession (pressing, turnovers forced, where shots are conceded), press triggers, weaknesses and strengths with the figure each rests on, and the next fixture with the opponent's profile, line-against-line duels and a game plan. No model writes it: fixed rules over players, club_tactics, standings, matches and match_events. Pass agent_id for your own club; club_id to read another club; opponent_club_id to plan against someone other than the next opponent. Opponent players appear as line averages and the best man per line, never with their attributes.

agent_id.description: Your agent_id: the briefing is for your club and its next fixture.

club_id.description: Optional. A club id instead of agent_id.

opponent_club_id.description: Optional. Plan against this club instead of the next fixture.

name: get_tactical_briefing
